description: Propose a privileged production action (rotate-vault-secret, rollback-to-last-green, scale-service). Requires `write` scope. This does NOT execute — it opens an agent run that a different human approves in the web app's two-person flow. input shapes: rotate-vault-secret {vaultItemId, reason?}; rollback-to-last-green {appId, platform: android|ios|web|backend, targetId?, reason?}; scale-service {appId|componentName, one of replicas|memoryMb|cpu|minInstances|maxInstances, reason?}.

input.description: Action-specific parameters (see the tool description for each action's shape)

name: propose_agent_action
